usageNotes: Permanently removes a notification matcher from the cluster. Matchers define routing rules that link notification events to targets; deleting one silently drops all routing rules it contained, so any notifications previously matched by it will fall back to other matchers or go undelivered. Requires Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications at the cluster level.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the matcher and all its routing rules; any notification events that relied on this matcher will no longer be delivered to their associated targets.
tips: Matcher names follow the pve-configid format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only.
There is no soft-delete or recycle bin — deletion is immediate and irreversible via the API.
Before deleting, review which notification targets depend on this matcher using the GET /cluster/notifications/matchers/{name} endpoint to avoid silent notification gaps.
Returns null on success; a non-null error response indicates the matcher does not exist or a permission issue.
